definitions.explanation: A style of sushi in which various toppings such as raw fish, egg, and vegetables are scattered over a bed of vinegared rice in a bowl.

examples.japanese: ちらし{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{昼|ひる}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ちらし{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ちらし{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's our family's tradition to make and eat chirashi-zushi together on Girls' Day.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦ちらし→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧ (scattering, from ちらす "to scatter") + {寿司|ずし}. Named for the way toppings are scattered over the rice.
Toppings and style vary by region. Edo-style (Tokyo) features raw fish sliced on top, while other regions may mix ingredients into the rice.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A popular dish for celebrations, especially ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (Girls' Day, March 3). Home-made versions often feature {錦糸|きんし}⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (thin egg strips), ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧ (shrimp), and ⟦{蓮根|れんこん}→蓮根：13994_renkon⟧ (lotus root). Restaurant versions typically feature sliced raw fish.
